no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: All current InMed drug candidates (INM-901 for Alzheimer's disease, INM-089 for dry AMD, INM-088 for glaucoma) are at preclinical / proof-of-concept stage with no active IND or ongoing clinical trials.
